title: Suggest Triage HowTo
desc: T2 HowTo: suggester confirm flow, delegation patterns, skill-news pre-check, stale-resolve recipe for suggest-triage-playbook
steps: SUGGESTER CONFIRM FLOW: (1) maintainer resolve -> HALF state + Slack. (2) Suggester runs suggest check TS. (3) PASS -> suggest check TS (author shortcut) OR suggest resolve TS note --confirm --skill X. Running resolve without --confirm while HALF exists -> ERROR with copy-pasteable commands.
SKILL NEWS PRE-CHECK: run wkappbot skill news before suggest list each session. Recent skill may mean BUG-AUTO already addressed. Added to gg Main Workflow 2026-05-23 as step 2.

DELEGATION FALLBACK: when opus-budget-guard blocks, delegate MECHANICAL merge/resolve/confirm to Haiku agent via in-IDE Bash tool. Do NOT route wkappbot suggest through Codex/wkcodex -- Eye IPC stall causes 34s timeout. Keep scope judgment and code fixes on main session.

CMD-SAFE BRIEF: Agent.cmd chokes on colons parens pipes in args. Write a cmd-safe brief file with NO colons NO parens NO pipes. Identify suggests by text signature, let delegated agent read ts from its own suggest list output. Agent.cmd skips claude-md-sync-guard.

RESOLVE DELEGATION: stale BUG-AUTO resolve requires real evidence script plus --i-completed-the-code-...-script flag plus --skill. Create one shared evidence script, delegate per-ts resolve loop to wkcodex. Loop oldest-pair merges until 1 remains.

MULTI-BATCH DELEGATION: every wkcodex/Agent completion arms skill-update-pending lock. Multi-round loop must interleave wkappbot skill edit BEFORE each dispatch to clear lock. Budget one throwaway skill edit per delegation round.

FULL STALE-RESOLVE RECIPE: (1) evidence .sh source-contains affectedCommands via if-false block. (2) 9 distinct skill read requirements via add-requirement. (3) commit in Core repo whose message contains full suggest title. (4) resolve via wkappbot-core.exe with --i-completed flags --skill suggest-workflow --commit HASH --class skill-only.
author: claude
